name: Document Type 7 Code
definition: Specifies a type of financial or commercial document.

JNRL.name: Journal
JNRL.definition: When the POI or the Sale System wants to store a message on the journal printer or electronic journal of the Sale Terminal (it is sometimes a Sale Logging/Journal Printer).

CRCP.name: Customer Receipt
CRCP.definition: When the Sale System requires the POI system to print the Customer receipt.

HRCP.name: Cashier Receipt
HRCP.definition: When the Sale system print the Cashier copy of the Payment receipt.

SRCP.name: Sale Receipt
SRCP.definition: When the Sale System requires the POI system to print the Sale receipt.

RPIN.name: Related Payment Instruction
RPIN.definition: Document is a linked payment instruction to which the current payment instruction is related, for example, in a cover scenario.

VCHR.name: Voucher
VCHR.definition: Document is an electronic payment document.
